purpose: This module provides pure functions for selecting the best calibration configuration based on score metrics. It filters rows (grid candidates vs non-candidates), applies optional quality floors, and generates sortable keys using different criteria: strict F1 score, coverage, alignment tightness, and merge counts. The module is orchestrated by an upstream component (B6) that computes diagnostics and decides whether to declare a winning configuration.

public_api.name: standard_tail
public_api.role: Deterministic tie-breaker for all sort keys; orders by fewest changed settings, then by settings tuple. Called by every key function to settle otherwise-identical configurations.

public_api.name: boundary_live_key_rally_id_f1
public_api.role: Returns the strict-boundary sort key for selecting the best config based on strict F1 score and alignment median. Callers use this when the primary goal is strict performance (clean coverage) with tight alignment.

public_api.name: boundary_report_key_fewest_merges
public_api.role: Returns a report-mode sort key prioritizing fewest span merges and split/missed/spurious counts. Callers use this to report configurations with minimal auxiliary side effects.

public_api.name: boundary_report_key_coverage_first
public_api.role: Returns a report-mode sort key prioritizing coverage fraction. Callers use this to rank configurations by how much ground truth is covered, secondarily by merge counts.

public_api.name: boundary_report_key_tightest_start
public_api.role: Returns a report-mode sort key prioritizing tightest absolute start alignment median. Callers use this to find configurations with the most precise rally-start detection.

public_api.name: f1_raw_5
public_api.role: Computes raw +/-5 frame F1 score from recall and precision metrics, or returns None if either metric is missing. Used by contact selection and validation logic.

public_api.name: contact_meets_floors
public_api.role: Checks whether a contact row satisfies optional precision and recall floor thresholds. Callers use this to filter ineligible contact configurations before live selection.

public_api.name: contact_live_key_floored_f1
public_api.role: Returns the live contact sort key, ranking by floored F1 score. Callers use this with pre-filtered rows that have already cleared metric floors and have valid F1 scores.

public_api.name: grid_rows
public_api.role: Filters input to return only rows marked as grid candidates (label='grid'); reference rows are excluded. Callers use this to isolate configurations that can win selection.

public_api.name: coverage_allowance_rows
public_api.role: Returns grid rows within a fractional coverage allowance of the best row's coverage count. Callers use this to narrow candidates when exact best coverage is not required.

public_api.name: select_contact_live_winner
public_api.role: Selects and returns the best contact configuration by floored F1 score, applying optional precision/recall floors. Returns None if no row is eligible. Top-level entry point for contact selection.

public_api.name: best_config_clears_quality_floor
public_api.role: Validates whether a candidate best-config row meets a minimum covered-fraction threshold. Callers use this to gate whether B6 reports a winning configuration at all.

public_api.name: ScoreRow
public_api.role: Type alias: dict[str, Any] holding a single configuration's score metrics (covered, covered_fraction, clean_covered, etc.). Used as the input unit for all selection functions.

public_api.name: SortKey
public_api.role: Type alias: tuple[Any, ...] representing a comparable sort order. Returned by every key function; ordered tuples are compared lexicographically by Python's min()/max().

public_api.name: GridKey
public_api.role: Type alias: Callable[[ScoreRow], SortKey]. Describes the signature of a ranking function that transforms a score row into a sortable key.
